runner: forge (stateless property/fuzz); Medusa/Echidna N/A — pure-math hooks, no stateful sequence adds coverage over per-call fuzz

invariants.name: testFuzz_nudgeRatchet_overBacking
invariants.description: NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook: fuzz amount(USDC 6dp, 0..1e18) x ratio[0,200]; assert debt == floor(amount*1e12*ratio/100), debt <= 200% of amount*1e12, floor is in protocol favour (never over-credit), and at ratio=100 scale lands exactly at 1e12.

invariants.name: testFuzz_uniboost_overBacking
invariants.description: UniboostMintDebtHook: fuzz prime decimals d in {6,8,18} (scale 1e12/1e10/1) x amount x ratio[0,50]; assert scale==10**(18-d), debt == floor(amount*scale*ratio/100), debt <= 50% ceiling, floor in protocol favour.

invariants.name: testFuzz_balancer_overBacking
invariants.description: BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook: unscaled (USDS 18dp) fuzz amount x ratio[0,50]; assert debt == floor(amount*ratio/100), debt <= 50% ceiling, floor in protocol favour.

invariants.name: test_M03_nudgeRatchet_1USDC_par_at_ratio100
invariants.description: 1 USDC (1e6) at ratio 100 => exactly 1e18 phUSD debt (par); asserts NOT 1e30 (double-scale) and NOT 1e6 (no-scale).

invariants.name: test_M03_uniboost6dp_1USDC_at_ratio50_isHalfPhUSD
invariants.description: Uniboost 6dp prime: 1 USDC at ratio 50 => 5e17 phUSD (scale 1e12 correct direction).

invariants.name: test_M03_balancer_1USDS_at_ratio50
invariants.description: Balancer unscaled: 1 USDS (1e18) at ratio 50 => 5e17 phUSD.

invariants.name: testFuzz_ratioCeilings_enforced
invariants.description: setRatio reverts above per-hook max (NudgeRatchet >200, Uniboost/Balancer >50), so the over-backing ceiling is enforced at the setter, not merely fuzzed.
